fieldValues.title: RFC-004: Language-Neutral Schema Notation for Spec Records
fieldValues.content: Draft: `ext:schema-notation`, a semantic, target-neutral schema definition model for spec authoring (JSON Schema / TypeScript / protobuf / Rust are projections). Carries the proposed-package / proposed-schemas boundary fixture under rfcs/rfc-004/. Full text: rfcs/rfc-004.md.
